rev0007_decision: Keep as one transfer-session integrity changeset; U-123 now has handler/timer proof and supplies the concrete guard requirement.
coherent_fix_shape: Reject or quarantine a duplicate username+token activation when the mapped transfer differs; make deactivation identity-checked; then bind FileTransferInit to the surviving expected transfer/session.
bad_combination_to_avoid: Do not make tokens globally unique across all users, and do not only add a duplicate guard while leaving stale timers able to delete a different object.

rev0007_decision: Related but not the same patch. Keep status messages bound to request generation/path state separately because UploadDenied/UploadFailed do not carry the transfer token.
coherent_fix_shape: Use local pending-download generation and expected virtual path state; do not invent protocol fields in remediation unless explicitly framed as a compatibility-changing extension.
bad_combination_to_avoid: Do not claim that a token guard fixes UploadDenied/UploadFailed, because those messages are username/path based in the current protocol shape.

rev0007_decision: Keep separate from U-123. It concerns completion/closure after bytes are sent, not token collision before file transfer starts.
coherent_fix_shape: Add upload completion state and close/retire completed file sockets; test slot release and statistics.
bad_combination_to_avoid: Do not fold upload-slot release behavior into the duplicate-token guard without an independent completion-state test.

rev0007_decision: Deferred. This remains high-risk, but rev0007 keeps momentum by finishing one transfer proof instead of expanding another broad batch.
coherent_fix_shape: One parser-ordering pass should combine token/source gate, policy early-drops, max-result budgets, and peer-connection close behavior.
bad_combination_to_avoid: Do not add only a UI cap while still decompressing/parsing/sorting attacker-controlled rows before policy and budget checks.
